No supports.","use_orientation":"Floor face against the work. The bolt comes in through the floor hole, threads through the nut and sticks out of the pocket side. When you tighten, the nut pushes against the floor, not against the press fit.","code":"import math
def build(p):
    R = p.knob_d/2.0
    H = p.knob_h
    k = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(H)
    k = k.edges().chamfer(1.0)
    n = int(p.grip_count)
    rc = R + p.scallop_r*0.4
    pts = [(rc*math.cos(2*math.pi*i/n), rc*math.sin(2*math.pi*i/n)) for i in range(n)]
    k = k.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints(pts).circle(p.scallop_r).extrude(H))
    k = k.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.bolt_clear_d/2.0).extrude(H))
    depth = p.nut_h + p.nut_recess
    af = p.nut_af + p.fit_offset
    ac = af/math.cos(math.pi/6)
    z0 = H - depth
    k = k.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).polygon(6, ac).extrude(depth))
    cpts = [((ac/2)*math.cos(math.pi/3*i), (ac/2)*math.sin(math.pi/3*i)) for i in range(6)]
    k = k.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).pushPoints(cpts).circle(p.corner_relief_r).extrude(depth))
    k = k.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-p.leadin).polygon(6, ac+0.6).extrude(p.leadin))
    return k
"},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"Flat bottom on the bed, pockets facing up. Print with the same settings as the knob.","use_orientation":"Handheld test piece","code":"import math
def build(p):
    pitch = 13.0
    L = 4*pitch + 2.0
    W = 14.0
    depth = p.nut_h + p.nut_recess
    H = 2.0 + depth
    c = cq.Workplane('XY').box(L, W, H, centered=(True, True, False))
    for i in range(4):
        x = -1.5*pitch + i*pitch
        af = p.nut_af + p.fit_offset + (i-1)*p.coupon_step
        ac = af/math.cos(math.pi/6)
        c = c.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').center(x, 0).circle(p.bolt_clear_d/2.0).extrude(H))
        c = c.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-depth).center(x, 0).polygon(6, ac).extrude(depth))
        cpts = [(x+(ac/2)*math.cos(math.pi/3*j), (ac/2)*math.sin(math.pi/3*j)) for j in range(6)]
        c = c.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-depth).pushPoints(cpts).circle(p.corner_relief_r).extrude(depth))
        c = c.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-p.leadin).center(x, 0).polygon(6, ac+0.6).extrude(p.leadin))
        for j in range(i+1):
            nx = x - 3.0 + j*1.6
            c = c.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').box(0.8, 1.2, H, centered=(True, False, False)).translate((nx, W/2.0-1.0, 0)))
    return c

It has four hex pockets marked with 1 to 4 notches on one edge: notch 1 = 7.90 mm, notch 2 = 8.00 mm, notch 3 = 8.10 mm, notch 4 = 8.20 mm across flats.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"2","text":"Press the nut into each pocket in turn. To get the nut back out, push a bolt or screwdriver through the hole underneath. Send me these four results and I'll set the knob pocket to the tightest (b) pocket.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"Print the knob with the flat solid face on the bed and the hex pocket facing up. The tip comes out of the pocket side.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}], "note": "Unchanged from the first version.
